high_level_description: A 1600x900 landscape structural draft of a rural meadow with sun-dappled grass, partly cloudy sky, a large ancient oak on the right featuring a low horizontal branch, a rusted fence in the left background, and a small distant clock tower — open foreground space preserved on left and right.

style_description.lighting: Bright daylight with soft sun dapples

compositional_deconstruction.background: Partly cloudy sky occupying top 55% of frame; sun-dappled grassy meadow below; open foreground zones left and right reserved.
